proposals.before: If again a Ban Menjian should appear, tabulating men ancient and modern, he would surely place Master Ouyang in the first rank of the nine grades; then though removed from the sages and worthies, there would be degrees yet not great distance; though his writing lacked the discernment of Xie and Yin, it would not harm his standing among posterity.
